notes: Two taḥwīl branches, each ending at Umar's report (لما كان يوم بدر) of the Prophet at Badr; the same saying.
Editor glosses «- واللفظ له -» and «- هو سماك الحنفي -» are left out. Abu Zumayl is kept as written and not merged with Simak (rule 9).
The Prophet is the end of the story and is not a link; the Companion Umar is the last link.
